text: You decided to let Safwan see it for himself.
It worked. That was the problem.
You don't answer the stranger. You say, Safwan. Look at the mirror.
But first, you step back. Out of the glass.
Safwan looks. Stairs. Railing. Candle. His own face.
No stranger.
His hand finds his whistle.
The stranger smiles.
Clever. Now he knows what I am.
Let's see how long until he knows what you are.
The whistle screams. He backs up the stairs.
Something falls from his coat. Otto's shop key.
His door slams. A room you were never invited into.
Safwan grabs your arm. You knew. How did you know?
He's pulled you back in front of the mirror.
In the glass, his hand is gripping nothing.
Then the tavern door bursts open. Captain Grete. Three lanterns.
She asks Safwan, where is he?
Safwan opens his mouth. And looks at the mirror.
What do you do before he speaks?
Top comment chooses your next move.
